organization.title: About TDRI
organization.description: Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) is an independent think tank focusing on evidence-based policy research to drive sustainable development and improve the quality of life for all.

quote: TDRI envisions a prosperous Thailand driven by high-quality research and effective policy recommendations.
